തന്നെ നിങ്ങളുടെ സുഹൃത്തുക്കൾക്ക് ഷെയർ
ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ട് കർത്താവിന്റെ പ്രേക്ഷിതരാവുക
english:
Praise the Lord, I give a thousand thanks to the Blessed Mother and the Holy Son, and when talking about the reason for coming here for the first time.
I should mention my name first.
My name is Babykutty Thomas, I belong to the Holy Family Church in the Vaanila parish, and I live in Ernakulam,
and it was on the 26/04/25 that I came here for the first time to make the Covenant.
I came here during a terribly difficult time in our lives, and as Father says, it was a time when things were completely beyond our natural human abilities.
We couldn't even think straight, and when things got that bad, I was praying the Holy Rosary,
and as I was reciting the fifth mystery, a thought suddenly came into my mind.
It was as if someone asked in my mind, "When Kreupasanam is there, why are you crying like this, shouldn't you be drawn to that place of grace?"
I thought it might be my own imagination, but it is true that I had heard of Kreupasanam,
and I knew it was in Alappuzha and knew all about it, but to actually come here was difficult.
To be able to come, I always say, "No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him,"
it was exactly that kind of divine pull.
I was in a state where I just couldn't wait for the dawn to break, so by 7:00 AM we started from there,
came here, made the Covenant, and only then did we leave.
I listened to the classes about it, but because I still didn't fully understand, I asked again,
wrote down what was said, read it over, and I would always ask the Blessed Mother about it.
I asked, "Mother, do I have the worthiness for this?", because we truly do not know,
and even though I pray the Chaplet of Divine Mercy and the Holy Rosary to Jesus, I was afraid to ask for anything.
I was afraid because this is a free gift of grace, so why should we ask, and we have no right to ask,
but when I came here, I understood that unless we fill the stone water jars with water, we will never receive the miracle,
and when I saw these six stone water jars, a thought came to my mind.
I thought, "My God, leaving a place with so much grace, where did we all run away to?",
and first of all, I tell everyone this, no matter what they have or haven't received.
Beyond these six prayer intentions, just come here, and this is my second time testifying here, because as soon as I stepped foot here,
a shivering thrill ran through my body, and when I looked at the Blessed Mother,
it felt as though she was asking me why I had delayed coming to her.
She was questioning me, so I said, "I did not know, Mother," and now I am declaring this as a testimony,
that on that day, I wore this blessed medal around my neck.
I wore it around my neck on the 26/04/25, and now I must also share the experience I received because that is when you truly understand.
I came to Kreupasanam, prayed and wrote down my Covenant intentions, and when writing the six intentions, I didn't know much,
so I wrote down all my sorrows, and finally came to the fifth one.
When I wrote it, I realized, "Oh God, I didn't ask for the grace to fulfill the Covenant conditions I wrote here,"
because I know it is completely beyond our human capacity.
I knew the Holy Mass might be missed, or sometimes the Holy Rosary might be missed, so I thought I should write that down too,
and I tell you, by the grace of God, for three months now, I haven't failed.
Up until today, I have never missed it, and from that day to this, if I set an alarm for 5:30 AM,
I am up by 5:00 AM, or even if I wake up at 5:15 AM,
Only after finishing my prayers do I even drink a cup of black coffee, and I only drink it after offering it to Jesus first,
and I always tell Jesus about this that this is truly a class for going to Heaven,
and just like how we send our children to study in English medium schools and in Ooty.
Father is drawn by God and is teaching us, and this is not just a worldly place,
but a spiritual school of intercession formed for us, as so many people here can attest.
People talk about kneeling down at 5:30 AM, and I have helped many people come here to take the Covenant, both financially and in other ways.
I call it a school of energy, and every time Father speaks, like he did the other day, I am just utterly moved by it.
Hearing that daily morning prayer, "It is just like a mother and children waiting in the evening to see what the father brings home from work."
"That is how eagerly these children wait to hear my prayer, Jesus", and it is truly the prayer of a mother, not just a father, pleading for her children.
We say, don't we, "Son, may you be blessed." and I wept during these five days of faith,
and as Father explained each step, I realized I haven't reached that far yet.
I pray, "May God allow me to climb that next step," and I say that if anyone has a chance to come here,
we should help them, or at the very least, speak to them.
We are obligated to tell everyone about it with our words, because the people here, the intercessors, and Father, are praying with broken hearts.
I have asked Jesus, "Jesus, why don't you make this priest a saint?", and to tell the truth,
when I hear him, I think there is absolutely nothing to discard in his words.
As the saying goes, there is nothing to throw away, and just like that, after listening to the retreat,
when I listen a second time, I wonder if I missed anything, because he draws us into such depths.
He brings us deep into the Word, without losing anything, and the promise he gives us perfectly mirrors Jesus’ words,
"that I should lose nothing of all that he has given me," is truly declared here before the Blessed Mother.
He testifies that ‘none of my children should be lost,’ and he does not mean only Christians or Hindus.
He says it's about believing in God, and having seen the Blessed Mother, I tell you that you can see the Mother too,
don't look at me, there's so many people who have seen her testify.
I am just sharing my testimony, and I am sharing the experience of coming to Kreupasanam, praying, and writing my Covenant intentions, and what happens when I do.
Whenever I pray, to tell the truth, I pray first, "Jesus, coming here or going to the church,
I acknowledge that I am the greatest sinner and the most foolish one."
I say this because, when looking at the various talents everyone else has, we are nowhere and have become nothing, so we stand outside in humility.
Unworthy as we are, He embraced us, and it is purely out of desire that I stand before Jesus, relying completely on His saving grace.
When I surrender, saying I am nothing, it is like a soldier raising his hands in surrender; will they shoot him?, and you just have to think of it like that.
I said, "My Jesus, my abilities have all been exhausted, my Mother, please intercede and speak a word to Jesus for me,"
And this is the healing I received from the pimples around my eyes.
Everyone told me it was an allergy from wearing eyeglasses, so I thought, 'If that's what it is, then so be it,' and I slowly let it go.
Then one day while praying, I thought, 'My God, even with the Holy Oil in my hands,
why haven't I been using it?', and from that day on,
I started applying it. Some days I would forget, but whenever I made the sign of the cross on my forehead,
I would immediately apply it here with both hands and say, "You will make this a testimony for me, won't You?",
but then I forgot about it. When I came here to renew the Covenant and was asked to write down the intentions,
I touched the spot and felt nothing there; the Blessed Mother had removed it completely.
To tell you the truth, I didn't even realize it; I only found out when I came here.
The second thing I want to share—what I just mentioned was about the Holy Oil—is about the blessing of the Kreupasanam blessed salt.
I used to remember hearing many testimonies about it, as we had a property partition issue that had been stalled for seven years.
It was just sitting there unresolved, and many times we would get so close to an agreement only for it to fall apart.
So, as Father instructed, this time everyone was gathering for a serious meeting,
and even the higher authorities were involved in the process, so I took this Kreupasanam blessed salt and,
starting from the steps leading up to our office, I sprinkled it on every step all the way into the manager's room,
and I prayed, "Jesus, just as You and Mother walk this path,",
"You both have come with me now, and it is You, along with the Twelve Apostles, who are going to speak; so that's fourteen plus me, making fifteen of us.",
"The rest are guests at the wedding, they must say that they have never tasted a wine like this before. Mother, this is my need" I said, and went inside.
I only prayed that no one would walk upstairs without stepping on this blessed salt. Because I recite 100 Apostles' Creed every single day, sometimes it gets interrupted,
Still recite the 325 Hail Marys. So if anyone hasn't been able to pray today—because in the past I didn't have that much time either—if anyone,
hasn't been able to pray the Holy Rosary today, I ask the Lord to give my prayers to them,
filling the gaps, just like a mother pouring oil into a vessel.
I say it's like pouring idli batter; I pour it out and say, "Mother, if there is an empty space anywhere, please fill it." As a result of interceding like this,
the issue that had been stalled for seven years was resolved through a discussion in four and a half hours, and we finalized the agreement right there.
Then, the next thing I want to share is when I received this Kreupasanam blessed medal; I put it in my bag and thought,
"My God, what if I lose it somewhere?",
I held it in my hand and prayed, "Where should I keep this? Please show me a good place to keep it safe," and just then, I saw a child,
wearing it around his neck. So I told the Blessed Mother, "Oh, I am so happy, I just need to wear it around my neck right?
Then it will be with me twenty-four hours a day.",
But after a while, because it was made of aluminum, the ring opened up a bit,
and I got scared, because as Father said, it absolutely must not be lost.
They will only replace it if the color fades. So I guard it as if it is my very own soul.
Even when going to bathe, I was afraid to take it off afraid to even set it aside, thinking,
"How can I be without Mother for that long?" So I spoke to the Sister,
and she smiled as I asked, "Can I change this aluminum and make it in gold?",
"If I do that, it won't get lost, right?" I spoke the truth, and the very next day—I am telling you a miracle—someone I never expected,
someone I never imagined would give it, gave me a gold chain to wear it on,
along with the matching piece, and I asked Mother, "Is this true? Is this really for me?",
Then Mother replied in my heart, "What did you ask for? A vessel to carry me,
right? Let it be fully made of gold." Just think about it, from that day until today,
I have not taken this medal off; I carry it with me constantly. Whenever I recite the Creed,
when I wake up in the morning, or when I am about to speak to someone, I immediately, take it, kiss it wherever I go,
I am now able to reading the Word of God during the Holy Mass but none of this was possible for me ever in my wildest dreams.
I didn't have the theological knowledge for it, or rather,
I had absolutely no worthiness for it whatsoever, yet He made it possible for me.
Then I went to the POC, attended classes, and was able to study a two-year course called 'Witness of Mercy',
and all the students there, the sisters, and the other religious were also there.
Mother helped me pass with 92% marks. When it comes to the Sacrament of Baptism and such,
I had only heard or read about them, but other than that,
to truly understand their depths, to understand and study the profound grace of each Sacrament, and to teach it today,
God is powerfully using me. So I tell you, a Mother who takes those who know nothing, and gathers all the scattered pieces from wherever they are tossed,
stringing them together into a beautiful pearl necklace and fastening the clasp for us,
such a Mother is our guardian. Then, the next testimony is a blessing I received: we had a lot of financial debts,
and we were finally able to take out some loans against our property.
and similarly, I owed about four and a half lakh rupees to my cousin sister.
She will not demand it, but I knew in my heart I had to repay it. While I was,
praying about it, I asked Mother, "Will you help me give it, if I pray 450 Hail Marys?"
I hadn't even finished the 450 Hail Marys; by the time I reached around 310,
I won't say their name, but someone else called and said, "Now, because you interceded for me, my visa and everything got sorted out, so I had made a vow,"
"and I had saved up some money, and it is for no one else but for you; I will send it to you, sister."
So I told them, "I won't be able to repay this to you immediately." They said, "I didn't ask you to return it; just give it back when you have the means."
And because of that, I was able to return the money I owed,
Then, when talking about apostolic works, I must say,
we had a car, actually two cars, and about one of them I asked Jesus, "As the Lord's vehicle, going everywhere it needs to go, what should be done with it?"
Looking around, I saw a charitable trust where the priests were traveling by taking taxis, and it wasn't an organization with abundant funds.
So we were able to donate the car to that trust, and that felt like a massive grace,
something we might never otherwise be able to do in our lifetime.
Then, similarly all our relatives and friends, many of whom are in the Gulf, had a lot of clothes, really high-quality clothes.
So I go to their houses, collect them, and distribute them to people according to their age. Those without passports, or those taking IELTS or German courses,
they call asking for intercessory prayers. They say they are going for their exams or interviews and need prayers,
and that they are only just starting to figure out the finances.
From somewhere in my mind, God reveals something that we don't urgently need right now. To tell the truth, it is such children that I am helping now.
What we give them is a lifeline, not just a saree or a blouse; if they pass an exam a whole family is saved.
Thinking like that, for those without passports, it used to cost 450 rupees back in the day, but now the expenses have changed drastically.
So I tell them to go forward with courage, and call to say passport and everything is sorted,
I know it's Jesus giving it to me somehow, not because of anything I have in my hands.
One thing I always say, and I say this truthfully, is that God touched me only when I admitted, 'Jesus, I am the most foolish of all.'
Because it is exactly when we stop and acknowledge that we lack knowledge, that God begins to work.
Having known and experienced this, I tell everyone that I used to be someone who had to look at the index to read the Bible.
I prayed to the Lord, fasting for 41 days, and asked to be able to quote at least ten verses, but I couldn't grasp the rest of the Word.
I told Jesus, 'Lord, I cannot even learn ten verses,' and on the 41st day, while I was praying with my eyes closed, I slowly dozed off.
Someone standing before me asked, 'Are these ten verses enough?', and I thought they might not be enough, but at least ten would do.
Then a coolness touched the tip of my tongue, and I tell you the truth, the Lord said,
'There is a Lord who will place what needs to be spoken on the tip of your tongue.
You don't need to run fast or rush, just walk slowly, for I will send My angel ahead of you to prepare the way and you must wait.'
Today, by God's grace, I can listen to everyone, and sometimes when accompanying the sick,
it might be the ladies' ward, where gents are not allowed inside.
In such places where I can go, I call them and say, 'You take rest,' and standing there,
I bathe the patients, pray the Holy Rosary, and put them to sleep.
The Lord has granted me the grace to do this, and for many who are dying, I always remember Mother Teresa's words.
She asked, ‘Can we give them a smile before they die, so that a smile may appear on their faces?—and that is my goal.’
Just as she said, 'This is the body of my Lord,' Mother Teresa laid each one on the table,
treating them as the body of Christ, and we too experience this.
Mother Teresa says that you don't have to be a biological mother or give birth to be a mother, and I took that to heart.
Whoever comes to me above 12 years old, Jesus always shows them to me as the 12-year-old lost child Jesus in the temple,
He asks me to gather them and do the work of the Lord,
and from that day on, regardless of their age or whether they are male or female, God has graciously given me many opportunities.
I have been able to bathe them, put them to bed, and massage their legs, and when I bathed an elderly man who couldn't do it himself, he said,
He said, 'For two years, I haven't known if water was falling on my back; I stand under the shower, but I couldn't feel if water was washing me there.'
He wept when I scrubbed and bathed him, realizing that water was finally washing his body after two years, and I realized that men are human too.
Women might easily say, 'My legs are aching,' but men never admit it, so I tell Jesus, 'Lord, there are so many fathers like St. Joseph walking around like this,
who endure the pain in silence and cannot ask for help.' We just need to ask Jesus to find them for us,
and Jesus will reveal them; I have received so many such graces.
We have been told during retreats that we should be able to share at least one Word of God with someone every day.
If we think about it, today with the internet and all, if we start a group, after praying in the morning for so many people,
we can ask, 'Lord, what is the message for today?' I have started a ministry called the Universal Media Ministry,
and every morning, whatever Jesus inspires in my heart, I share.
Especially after hearing things at Kreupasanam, I think, 'My God, Jesus who drew us in, just as in the days of John the Baptist preaching repentance.'
'Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand,' and just as this priest prepares us, these Sisters come in the morning.
I remember seeing them drinking water from a bottle, coming back again and again, quoting what we say, writing it down, and speaking it.
When I see this, I realize what is happening here: there is a Kingdom of Heaven here, and the Lord will show us that the house of Zacchaeus has been established again,
This is my world, and I see how much the Lord rejoices in Kreupasanam and in the retreat groups that are functioning well.
I think, 'Jesus, we are unable to look after even the affairs of our own homes sometimes, yet Jesus is prepared for us 24 hours a day.' I tell them there,
'Lord, what we must give is not just money, everyone knows that; but I must say, we are unable to give our time to Jesus and share it with others.'
There are so many mothers and fathers who suffer without a good listener,
and when I go to such places, they say, ‘My daughter, I am so happy that you came and touched me.’
They have waited for someone, and they have even kept cakes that have gone moldy, crying as they say they kept it to give to the child when they come.
They hide the moldy parts and say they will eat it later; such is the depth of love on this earth, yet they sit somewhere clinging to it.
It’s like fish caught in a net; they are meant for those outside. When we gather coconuts, we must leave some for the poor who glean.
If we want Malabar tamarind, it will bear fruit abundantly or coconuts will bear fruit abundantly,
but if we don't give any to anyone, Jesus will say, 'Didn't I give you 24 or 30? What if I gave you 10 instead?' When I started doing things like giving away what was gathered,
I realized everything is a free gift, and if we firmly believe in our hearts that even our next breath is a gift from God no one would sin.
Only when people leave a house of mourning do they become incredibly holy, including myself, vowing never to sin again.
But Jesus says, remember that what you saw before your eyes today could be you tomorrow, and with that in mind, I try to witness and draw as many as possible to Jesus;
and just like I mentioned about the vessel, sometimes when sitting in the church, I have looked at it with pain, seeing it covered in dust.
I said, "My God, all this dust is sitting on my Mother's body," and I have tried to shake it off, dry it in the sun, and give it back.
Sometimes I could not do it, but I say, whenever we see it lying like that, we must remember who this is; if it were an advertisement for our own child,
would we just leave it there? Never! When we see the paper containing the Word of Jesus—who gave us everything,
is the source of all abilities, and who died and lives for us even today— lying covered in dust at the church door,
our hearts should shatter. I truly say, we should break down and ask ourselves, for whom did Jesus do all this?
For whom did the Blessed Mother do all this? For all the Sisters, the priests, and such apostolic workers,
if we cannot do much, we should at least pray one Hail Mary, one Our Father, and one Glory Be every day, because unlike us,
we have a TV at home to watch, we have children, and we have friends to share our joy with.
To tell you the truth, think about the Sisters and the priest; when I go for a retreat,
or when I stand there for counseling, after ten days, we feel exhausted and think we can just leave on the eleventh day, right?
But what do they have? They are humans who have emptied themselves from head to toe for God. So, whatever we can do,
we should offer for them; even while washing clothes, we can say, "Lord, I offer the pain of washing these clothes to Jesus,"
and when we say that, we are interceding for the many children who have set out for Jesus.
Whoever they may be, we can say, "We offer our sufferings and joys for them; let the red roses we received today become white roses,
and we dedicate them for their sake." Then, speaking about my spiritual life, I must tell you the truth, every day to attend the Holy Mass,
I wake up at 5:30 AM, and as soon as my prayers are done, like I said, I drink a black coffee and run to the church. Sitting there,
inside the church—I am telling the truth—I walk around the inside of the church and try my maximum to pray one Holy Rosary and one Chaplet of Divine Mercy.
Only if the children are in a rush will I leave without doing that. I press my head right beneath Jesus' feet and say, "Lord, please grant me the grace,
to come and bow down like this tomorrow as well." Also, Father has told us to go to Confession once every two weeks, and God has ensured that until now,
it has never been broken, I can firmly say that. Similarly, regarding praying the Holy Rosary as much as possible, I remember what Vijayakumar Sir, who comes here, once said.
What that Sir said once, I remember: "When you are praying the Rosary and the Rosary in your hand slips down,
and after you pick it back up, are you able to know exactly which bead you were on and continue from there?"
That is truly a word that pierces the heart.
Just pay attention to this; we don't even need to fall asleep, sometimes if we just set it down, go somewhere, and come back, do we know which,
Hail Mary we stopped at? If you can recognize that, then your prayer is powerful; if we fold it up and leave,
do we know if we stopped at the fifth or the sixth?
If we know exactly where we stopped, that is true focus. Likewise, when attending the Holy Mass, as the priest says, 'Lord, may Your Holy Spirit come down,'
'and this is the body of the living God,' at least a drop of tear should fall from our eyes. Just as the Blessed Mother stands kneeling,
watching her Holy Son being torn apart. So, expressing my deepest gratitude to everyone, I say this: to attract many to God,
that Mother who appeared alive on the Kreupasanam altar is telling you right here that there is so much that she needs to accomplish through each and every one of us.
I sincerely pray that everyone may be able to come here and testify to this as soon as possible,
begging for the Mother's grace. One thing we must always say is, 'I have no ability,
my God, I am incapable.' As Father says, 'Relying on Your ability, I surrender my own,'
and pray, 'Bless me with a humble heart.' I give a thousand thanks to Father and all the apostolic workers serving here,
crying out before the Lord, 'Lord, uplift them ten thousandfold! May this place rise as a sanctuary of a Saint, as a Holy Kreupasanam!' Praying this,
I say, 'Thank You Jesus, Praise You Jesus. I will sing to the Lord, because He has dealt bountifully with me.' This is Psalm 13:6.
When we believe completely in God's mercy and faithfulness,
we will be able to sing and praise the Lord's mercies and blessings. To make known to those who do not know,
and to deepen the faith of those who already know, this sister has been able to do that apostolic work most beautifully. Bathing the sick,
seeing a smile on their faces before they die, and that desire and joy to do that ministry work for them—that joy is exactly what Jesus expects from us.
To share this with others, and for every blessing He graces our lives with, we are called to sing and praise the Lord.
We all have various hardships and difficulties in our lives.
When we surrender all of them to Jesus and place them in the hands of the Blessed Mother,
it is Mother who gives everything into the hands of Jesus. Let us also,
surrender all the hardships in our lives to God. Let us lead a Covenant life with faithfulness and devotion,
and may we too have the opportunity to praise and sing to the Lord.
Praying that it may be so, let us clap our hands and glorify God for all the blessings received by Babykutty Thomas and her family.
Thank You Jesus, Praise You Jesus, Ave Maria.
